name: Southwest Institute of Applied Electronics
supervisors: China Academy of Engineering Physics (per the Canadian and US lists)

evidence.summary: Canada’s Named Research Organizations list and the US Entity List both name the Southwest Institute of Applied Electronics among the known aliases of the China Academy of Engineering Physics (CAEP), which the US Commerce Department describes as the technology complex responsible for the research, development and testing of China’s nuclear weapons; the Entity List places CAEP’s named institutes in or near Mianyang.
